int_name: ALBERT EINSTEIN DR & N BROAD ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signal control. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the significant crossing distance across four lanes without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic, which increases their time of exposure to vehicles in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Median Refuge
hazards.description: There is no protected space in the center of the wide roadway for pedestrians to wait if they cannot complete the crossing in one cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to shorten the unprotected crossing distance and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide signalized intersection adjacent to an institutional campus. While sidewalks and basic crosswalks are present, the large crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands on the main thoroughfare create a car-centric environment.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The main roadway is very wide, exposing pedestrians to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center, across the main multi-lane road.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: No median or island is present to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the main road to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder style markings for better visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings but lacks a pedestrian refuge island. While overhead traffic signals are present, no dedicated pedestrian signals are visible, and the long crossing distance increases exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The police vehicle and truck parked near the intersection may block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signals are present, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The image shows a marked zebra crosswalk at an intersection near a formal gated entrance. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the pedestrian path is partially obstructed by metal barricades, and there is a lack of active traffic control signals.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Metal crowd-control barricades are placed across the sidewalk and corner area, restricting pedestrian movement and potentially forcing people into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk corner near the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Active Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs, traffic lights, or pedestrian signals to manage the interaction between vehicles and pedestrians at this crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense foliage from street trees may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the perspective of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line to the right of the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Constructing curb extensions would shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing warning signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Clearance of Obstructions
interventions.description: Remove the metal barricades to ensure the full width of the sidewalk and the curb ramp are accessible to all users.
